name: Build a backup recovery rehearsal
why: Ranks your systems and writes a safe restore test with an evidence log, the same method as the backup and restore plan skill.

name: Recovery rehearsal evidence assistant
why: Checks restore test results against your recovery targets and lists the gaps with owners, for the quarterly restore test.

name: Lock down your store logins and staff against takeover
why: Builds a sign-in policy, fix list and phishing rule sheet from your team and apps, a quick start before a full tenant baseline.

name: Sign-in security checker
why: Scores how staff sign in and writes a one-page password and second-step policy, matching the MFA and password rules in this kit.

name: Staff phishing rules briefer
why: Writes a staff phishing rule sheet and a ten-minute drill, useful alongside MFA rollout and the incident first-hour prompt.

name: Write a procedure, test it and build a training deck
why: Turns a process into a tested written procedure and a training deck, handy for runbooks and staff how-tos.

name: Slack and backup planner
why: Finds where one bad week would break the business and what backup to add first, a wider view before the backup plan.
